basics.name: Fabien MATHE
basics.label: Student
basics.summary: A passionate student of robotics and mechatronics. Responsible for the design and automation of Zéphyr, an autonomous sailing research trimaran. Driven by complex challenges and committed to contributing to cutting-edge projects.

work.name: Ifremer - French national institute for ocean science and technology
work.summary: Contributing to PhD research on visual SLAM for underwater robotics, and contribute to the development and integration of the Stonefish simulator

work.name: Czech Technical University
work.description: Worked on advanced mechanical and mechatronic simulations under the supervision of Prof. Ing. Michael Valášek.

work.name: IMATH Laboratory & HydroSharks
work.description: Developed simulations and conducted mechanical studies related to the HydroSharks naval engineering projects.

volunteer.summary: Managed and coordinated naval construction projects, including the development of an autonomous trimaran.

education.area: Structural Analysis and Numerical Modeling (Finite and Volume Elements)
projects: 3rd year - Underground robotic exploration and multi-robot coordination
2nd year - Underwater image classification using neural networks
1st year - Design and simulation of innovative foils for low-speed leisure catamarans

education.field: PCSI (Physics, Chemistry, and Engineering Science) - PSI (Physics and Engineering Science)
education.competition_project: Construction of a 3-axis Cartesian robot for automatic waste sorting, with an algorithm based on color and size detection

references.title: Head - Division of Mechanics and Mechatronics
references.name: Prof. Ing. Michael Valášek

projects.name: Zephyr - Autonomous Sailing Trimaran
projects.summary: Led a team of 20 students in the design and automation of a 5-meter autonomous sailing trimaran. Developed obstacle detection and avoidance algorithms, navigation systems, and automation processes.

projects.name: Eel-Inspired Robot Design
projects.summary: Designed a bio-inspired robotic system for underwater cave exploration.

projects.name: Real-Time Sailing Simulator
projects.summary: Developed a multi-physics simulation of a sailing yacht, including realistic environment modeling and statistical weather systems. Designed for AI training and long-term mission planning.
